E4Plus1.uk.description: Lost Our Lisa: Lisa's museum visit plans are ruined when Bart glues novelty items to his face. So she decides to go alone on the bus, but ends up on the wrong side of town... (S9 Ep24/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Christmas: When Captain Holt gets death threats, Peralta must run his security. Santiago tries to take a precinct Christmas photo for Holt, but Diaz won't smile for the camera. (S1 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Pontiac Bandit: In order to catch the Pontiac Bandit, a car thief he's been tracking for years, Peralta tries to make a deal with a suspect who Diaz has just arrested. (S1 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Do Not Push: A campus tour becomes an emotionally and psychologically charged experience for the Dunphys. (S6 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Cold: Phil must get rid of some incriminating footage on Mitch and Cam's wedding video. (S6 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Marco Polo: The Dunphys move into a cramped hotel room while their house is getting treated for mould. (S6 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Won't You Be Our Neighbor: Phil is selling the house next door and he and Claire are excited by the prospect of having wonderful new neighbours. (S6 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Three Gays of the Condo: After realising that Marge only married him because she was pregnant with Bart, Homer moves out and ends up sharing an apartment with two gay men. (S14 Ep17/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Dude, Where's My Ranch?: After Homer has a hit record with an anti-Ned Flanders Christmas carol, the family decide to get away from it all at a ranch. (S14 Ep18/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Old Yeller Belly: Santa's Little Helper becomes Duff Beer's new mascot after he's banished from the Simpson home for failing to save Homer from a tree house fire. (S14 Ep19/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brake My Wife, Please: When Homer is banned from driving, Marge gets stressed ferrying everyone around, but Homer enjoys walking everywhere - until Marge crashes into him. (S14 Ep20/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mercedes sees a side to Jenson that she doesn't like, and Myra finds a hidden camera in the house... Elsewhere, things look up for one family, while panic sets in for another.

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer's Triple Bypass: Homer has a heart attack while he's watching TV. The hospital says he needs a bypass, but Homer can't afford it. Of course, there's always Dr Nick... (S4 Ep11/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Married at First Sight USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The newly-weds are brought back to earth with a bump when they move in together and start facing the challenges - and arguments - of regular married life. (S19 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Celebs Go Dating
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: After an eventful mixer, Gabby and Joel discuss whether they can see a future together. And it's an emotional day for Stephen as he opens up to the agents. (S15 Ep16/20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: On the Box: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors, Sex, Love & Goop, Coronation Street, Strictly Come Dancing, The Cube, Celebrity Ghost Trip and This Morning. (S18 Ep7)
